title: Wild Blue
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Wave on Wave”, a luxury 8-bed, 8 full & 2 half-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 19 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Gulf Views, Elevator & Golf Cart. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Private Resort Style Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day from October 1 - May 1) -Gulf Views -Elevator -6 Adult Bikes -6 Seater Golf Cart Introducing “Wild Blue” a captivating 8-bedroom, 10-bathroom Gulf-view haven nestled in the historic scrub oaks of Old Seagrove Beach. This modern coastal retreat redefines luxury with its vibrant design and exceptional amenities, accommodating up to 19 guests for a truly unforgettable experience. Step into the first floor, where a cozy living space awaits, complemented by two guest bedrooms and convenient laundry facilities. The private lanai beckons with a half-covered resort-style pool, lounge chairs, and access to the outdoor kitchen equipped with a gas grill, mini fridge, ice maker, and a dining table—a perfect spot to soak up the sun or enjoy a refreshing swim. The second-floor main living space is stunning and exudes modern luxury, featuring an opulent layout that seamlessly blends the main living, dining, and kitchen areas. Adorned with 200-year- old wood beams and shiplap walls, the great room offers a warm atmosphere with an oversized sectional couch, armchairs, and a large fireplace. The gourmet kitchen boasts designer cabinets and a stylish dine-in granite island. This floor also hosts two guest bedrooms and provides direct access to the front balcony. Ascend to the third floor, where three bedrooms await— including a primary bedroom with a soaking tub, a guest room, and a bunk room. The floor also boasts a full-sized laundry space, a private TV room, and a balcony for moments of relaxation. The pinnacle of luxury awaits on the top floor, where an outdoor covered deck offers stunning Gulf views. This view lounge features two dining tables and a sectional sofa for an enchanting experience. Step inside to find a wet bar and mini fridge, making this space special. For year-round entertainment, explore the nearby iconic town of Seaside, just a short distance away. With Gulf views throughout the home, a private pool, and quick access to the beach via guest golf cart or bikes, “Wild Blue” is more than a vacation destination—it’s an elegant and timeless tradition for families and friends alike. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom With Shower Only - California King Bedroom - Shared Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo SECOND FLOOR: - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom With Shower Only - Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom With Shower Only Third Floor - Master Bedroom with King Bed - Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate - Bunkroom - Twin-over-Queen Bunk Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed - Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Fourth Floor - Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom With Shower Only
